DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
	TREATAS({"Chennai"}, 'Sales'[City])

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(__DS0FilterTable, "Average_Order_Value", IGNORE('Sales'[Average Order Value]))

DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
	TREATAS({"Chennai"}, 'Sales'[City])

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(__DS0FilterTable, "Profit_Margin", IGNORE('Sales'[Profit Margin]))

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Chennai"}, 'Sales'[City])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Sales'[City],
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('Sales'[Solution], "IsGrandTotalColumnTotal"),
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"CountOrderID", CALCULATE(COUNTA('Sales'[OrderID]))
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreOnlyOutputTotals = 
		SELECTCOLUMNS(
			KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core), [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal] = FALSE)),
			"'Sales'[City]", 'Sales'[City],
			"'Sales'[Solution]", 'Sales'[Solution],
			"CountOrderID", [CountOrderID]
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreTableByDM0 = 
		SELECTCOLUMNS(
			KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core), [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal] = TRUE)),
			"'Sales'[City]", 'Sales'[City],
			"SortBy_DM0_0", [CountOrderID]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWithSortColumns = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Sales'[City]),
			__DS0CoreTableByDM0
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(201, __DS0PrimaryWithSortColumns, [SortBy_DM0_0], 0, 'Sales'[City], 1)

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0CoreOnlyOutputTotals, 'Sales'[Solution])

	VAR __DS0Secondary = 
		TOPN(62, __DS0SecondaryBase, 'Sales'[Solution], 1)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWindowed,
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
				__DS0CoreOnlyOutputTotals,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0Secondary,
				'Sales'[Solution],
				ASC
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Secondary

ORDER BY
	'Sales'[Solution]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	[SortBy_DM0_0] DESC, 'Sales'[City], [ColumnIndex]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Chennai"}, 'Sales'[City])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Sales'[Product], __DS0FilterTable, "Total_Sales", 'Sales'[Total Sales])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Total_Sales], 0, 'Sales'[Product], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Total_Sales] DESC, 'Sales'[Product]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Chennai"}, 'Sales'[City])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[Year],
			'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[Quarter],
			'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[QuarterNo],
			'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[Month],
			'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[MonthNo],
			'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[Day],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Total_Sales", 'Sales'[Total Sales],
			"MinDate", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[Date])))
		)

	VAR __DS0IntersectionCount = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0Core))

	VAR __DS0BodyBinnedSample = 
		SAMPLEAXISWITHLOCALMINMAX(3500, __DS0Core, [MinDate], [Total_Sales], 350, , ALPHABETICAL, ASC, 105000, 60)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
	"DS0IntersectionCount", __DS0IntersectionCount
)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyBinnedSample

ORDER BY
	'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[Year],
	'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[QuarterNo],
	'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[Quarter],
	'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[MonthNo],
	'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[Month],
	'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[Day]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Chennai"}, 'Sales'[City])

	VAR __DM3FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({2026}, 'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[Year])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(
				'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[Year], "IsGrandTotalRowTotal",
				ROLLUPGROUP(
						'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[Quarter],
						'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[QuarterNo]
					),
				"IsDM1Total",
				NONVISUAL(__DM3FilterTable)
			),
			__DS0FilterTable
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			502,
			__DS0Core,
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			0,
			'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[Year],
			1,
			[IsDM1Total],
			0,
			'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[QuarterNo],
			1,
			'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[Quarter],
			1
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC,
	'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[Year],
	[IsDM1Total] DESC,
	'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[QuarterNo],
	'LocalDateTable_7245a007-4275-45c4-aeed-6a8e9b7b5655'[Quarter]
